verdict.rationale: Copilot documents task delegation directly: users assign tasks to agents that plan and execute autonomously in the background, mention @copilot on pull requests to request changes, and use agent mode in the editor, all natively inside GitHub. The documentation covers launching, tracking and reviewing delegated work. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation (community evidence covers only code completion).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Assign tasks to agents like Copilot, Claude by Anthropic, and OpenAI Codex, and let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
Mention `@copilot` in a comment on an existing pull request to ask it to make changes.
